title: kube.workload.pause input
description: Suspends one observed pod Job (a finite job or a long-lived service) addressed by run id. The caller supplies the exact opaque resourceVersion observed at admission (via kube.workload.summarize or kube.snapshot.read); it is the compare-and-swap and is never re-fetched or interpreted by the runtime. Operation id, idempotency digest, worker identity, and exact patch are resolved by the trusted runtime. approvalId is a model-supplied selector naming the exact approval on the phase-two dispatch — never itself authority: the kernel consumes that exact approval server-side.

approvalId.description: Model-supplied selector naming the exact kernel approval on the phase-two dispatch — never itself authority: the kernel consumes that exact approval server-side.

expectedResourceVersion.description: Opaque Kubernetes resourceVersion of the addressed Job as observed at admission.

checkpoint.description: Also capture the paused pod's per-pod state as a checkpoint artifact (its id comes back as checkpoint). Resume continues from the same state either way.
